title: Product measure for a uniform sample matrix
statement: Let $n,m$ be natural numbers and let $\mathcal F$ be a finite family of subsets of the $n$ coordinate indices. The measure associated with a uniform random matrix indexed by $\mathcal F$, with each row consisting of $m$ inputs from $\{−1,1\}^n$, is the product over $S\in\mathcal F$ of the measures associated with uniform random $m$-tuples of such inputs.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal F$ is a finite family of subsets of the $n$ coordinate indices
